name: buildr-vscode
description: Local-model-first agentic coding workflows for VS Code.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Buildr runs in read-only Plan Mode until the workspace is trusted.

chatParticipants.name: buildr
chatParticipants.description: Plan Buildr coding tasks from VS Code Chat.

languageModelTools.name: buildr_workspaceContext
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find relevant files and summaries from the current workspace.

query.description: Task or topic to search for.

buildr.model.provider.description: Default model provider used by Buildr.

buildr.model.ollamaBaseUrl.description: Ollama endpoint reachable from the active extension host.

buildr.model.lmStudioBaseUrl.description: LM Studio endpoint reachable from the active extension host.

buildr.model.modelId.description: Default model id sent to the configured provider.

buildr.context.tokenBudget.description: Maximum context token budget Buildr should target.

buildr.context.hardTokenCap.description: Hard cap for tokens Buildr may send or generate in one agent session. Buildr blocks before a model call that would exceed this cap.

buildr.context.warningThresholds.description: Fractional token budget thresholds that emit warnings during an agent session.

buildr.agents.maxParallelSubAgents.description: Maximum number of Buildr sub-agents that may run in parallel.

buildr.agents.coderReviewRetryLimit.description: Maximum coder/reviewer attempts per agent task. Set to 0 for Auto: 5 attempts for local models and 3 attempts for cloud models.

buildr.agents.lintFixRetryLimit.description: Maximum number of lint-fix iterations before continuing without clean lint. Set to 0 to disable the lint gate.

buildr.cost.inputUsdPerMillion.description: Estimated input-token cost in USD per million tokens for the configured model. Local providers default to zero.

buildr.cost.outputUsdPerMillion.description: Estimated output-token cost in USD per million tokens for the configured model. Local providers default to zero.

buildr.permissions.defaultWritePolicy.description: Default policy for tools that can modify files or run commands.

buildr.privacy.cloudSendPolicy.description: Controls whether Buildr may send workspace context to non-local providers.

buildr.rules.rulePacks.description: Rule packs Buildr applies before completion.

buildr.verification.level.description: Verification strictness for completion gates and warnings.

buildr.embeddings.provider.description: Embedding provider for semantic context ranking.
